channel.title: Sourav Lahon — Blog
channel.description: Stories, thoughts, and things worth writing down — engineering deep-dives and notes from building things.

item.title: A Complete Coaching Center Management System — Website, Dashboards, Live Classes, Billing
item.description: What I built for Success Point Gogamukh wasn't just a website — it's a full operating system for a coaching business. Every feature, every screen, and what it would take to build one for your institute.

item.title: Success Point Gogamukh — The Full Technical Build
item.description: Next.js App Router and Server Actions, a Prisma/PostgreSQL schema built around live classes, phone+OTP auth with per-attempt SMS cost tracking, Web Push, an offline-ready PWA, and an immutable audit log — the full engineering breakdown of a real client platform.

item.title: Why It Matters to Digitalise Your Business, Entity, and Identity
item.description: A signboard and word of mouth used to be enough. For coaching centers and schools competing for the same batch of NEET, JEE, and ADRE aspirants, they no longer are.

item.title: Wormhole — Engineering a Serverless, End-to-End Encrypted Messenger
item.description: A private tunnel between exactly two phones — WebRTC, NaCl encryption, no servers in the middle. Every diagram, flowchart, and hard-won lesson from building it.

item.title: Why I'm Building Innercast
item.description: Mental health is the one thing we track the least about ourselves, yet it shapes everything else. A private, on-device mood diary that checks in daily and writes the story back to you.
